scope: Research-only transaction spike; NOT Vercy installation or metamodel acceptance
limits: Trusted test session, policy, clock and fixture administration, no real authentication
Single local SQLite store, no external effect or native Vercy event export

No full schema, whole-object specification, audit, publication or production authorization claim
